| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Element shape** `shape` | Disk | Disk, Square, Diamond | The shape of the elements. Size i uses disk i, the square of side 2 i + 1, or diamond i. |
| **Largest size** `size` | 3 | 1 to 6 | The number of sizes. Each size adds an opening and a closing. |
| **Order** `order` | Opening first | Opening first, Closing first | Whether each size opens before it closes, or closes before it opens. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
